raw_response:
This small plot is my enset and a few coffee trees mixed together, just beside the house. I have kept it this way since my father's time, and I only put the cattle manure from our kraal around the enset base — I do not buy fertilizer from the cooperative for this plot, it is too small and the bag is too big. The seed question does not really apply here because enset suckers come from my own mother plants, not from any agro-dealer. My wife and I weed it and tend the enset ourselves when we have time between the bigger plots.
